jobs.title: Technical Support & Implementation Specialist (m/w/d)

Wir führen DocuWare, digitale Workflows und Schnittstellen bei unseren Kunden ein und betreuen sie im laufenden Betrieb. Für unseren Bereich Technischer Service & Implementierung suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest etwa zu gleichen Teilen im Support und in der Implementierung und sicherst beides durch saubere Dokumentation ab. Support (ca. 45 %) Du betreust unsere Kunden im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support per Telefon, E-Mail, Ticketsystem und Fernwartung. Du analysierst und behebst Störungen an Kundeninstallationen, Schnittstellen und Prozessen. Du eskalierst bei Bedarf an den Hersteller-Support und verfolgst den Fall bis zur Lösung. Du führst Updates, Patches und Wartungsarbeiten im Rahmen bestehender Verträge durch. Implementierung (ca. 40 %) Du installierst, konfigurierst und nimmst Lösungen beim Kunden in Betrieb, on-premises und in der Cloud. Du setzt die im Projekt abgestimmten Anforderungen und Workflows um. Du bindest bestehende Kundensysteme über Schnittstellen und Konnektoren an. Du migrierst Daten, testest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden und begleitest die Abnahme. Du weist Anwenderinnen und Anwender ein und übergibst die Lösung in den laufenden Betrieb. Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung (ca. 15 %) Du pflegst die kundenbezogene System- und Konfigurationsdokumentation. Du hältst Störungen und Lösungswege im Ticketsystem und in der Wissensdatenbank fest. Du testest konfigurierte Prozesse und Workflows vor der Übergabe und erstellst Abnahmeprotokolle. The brilliant minds at ASM are dedicated to developing groundbreaking solutions for the world s leading semiconductor manufacturers. Every day, we drive the development of next-generation computer chip technologies, staying a few steps ahead of the future. Our talented and enthusiastic employees are just like you: committed to improving people s lives and unlocking new possibilities. Through a collaborative approach to research and development, we advance key semiconductor technologies and platforms such as ALD, epitaxy, PEALD, PECVD, and vertical furnaces. We have also recently entered the promising growth market of silicon carbide epitaxy. Year after year, our innovations help make chips smaller, faster, and more powerful. In fact, you can find our technology in every aspect of modern life: in artificial intelligence, medical devices, 5G, smartphones, autonomous driving, and more. jobs.description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams. jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics. The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small. What you'll do Mentor the mechanical engineers day

jobs.description: Zur Verstärkung unseres DEA-Regler-Teams suchen wir Dich als Werkstudent:in in der SPS-Programmierung (m/w/d), in dieser Rolle unterstützt Du unsere SPS-Programmierer bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Automatisierungslösungen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und qualitätsorientiert, trägst zur Effizienzsteigerung unserer Projekte bei und sammelst wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Umfeld. Über ee technik gmbh Seit über 10 Jahren entwickeln wir smarte Automatisierungslösungen für stabile Stromnetze – überwiegend Fernwirktechnik, Einspeisemanagement und EZA-/DEA-Regler Systeme. Unser Team aus Ingenieur:innen und Techniker:innen arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Energiewende und digitaler Infrastruktur. Die ee technik gmbh ist nach DIN ISO 9001 zertifiziert – Prozessklarheit, Qualität und Verlässlichkeit sind keine Versprechen, sondern gelebter Alltag. Dein Versprechen: „Ich trage mit Engagement zur Unterstützung unserer Automatisierungsprojekte bei: neugierig, lernbereit und zuverlässig. Ich nutze die Chance, praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln, und bin bereit, mein Wissen aktiv einzubringen. Ich stelle sicher, dass unsere Aufgaben effizient und strukturiert bearbeitet werden und unterstütze das Team mit frischen Perspektiven.“ Wenn das dein Arbeitsstil ist, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Hier kannst du wertvolle Praxiserfahrungen sammeln und in einem motivierten Team wachsen. Du möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen in der Praxis anwenden und die Automatisierungstechnik hautnah erleben? jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY . The role You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it) Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel What we’re looking for We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation. jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. jobs.description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations ! Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation

Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal. About the Role Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges. Challenges You’ll Work On Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work. Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches. Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt. Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs). Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle. Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems. About You You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier

jobs.description: greenteg AG develops high-tech thermal sensing solutions for an international customer base. Main tasks: Calibrate sensors and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models on customer devices. Plan and conduct data collection and validation studies. jobs.description: Möglichkeit, von unseren Büros in Genf oder Bern aus zu arbeiten. Du begeisterst dich für Finanzen und Rechnungswesen, möchtest aber über die Zahlen hinausgehen und aktiv zur Digitalisierung von Unternehmen beitragen? Bei Fidigit stehen unsere Kunden im Mittelpunkt, denn wir bieten dank der Einführung von Abacus ERP und unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden einen aussergewöhnlichen Service. Als Teil der Fidinam-Gruppe, eines führenden Beratungsunternehmens in den Bereichen Steuern, Unternehmen, Immobilien und digitale Beratung in der Schweiz, sind wir mit mehr als 15 Standorten weltweit und über 300 Beratern hervorragend aufgestellt. Mit Standorten in Bern, Genf, Lugano, Luzern und Zürich sind wir der einzige Abacus-Vertriebspartner, der in allen drei Sprachregionen der Schweiz vertreten ist. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, unsere Kunden in den Bereichen Digitalisierung und Prozessoptimierung zu beraten. Was du bei uns tun wirst: Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei ihren Abacus-Finanzprojekten, von der Konzeption über die Einführung bis hin zur Schulung. Du bist als Berater und Teilprojektleiter tätig und übernimmst die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich. Du analysierst Finanzprozesse und entwickelst passende Lösungen in Abacus. Du arbeitest an Themen wie Finanzflüssen, Kostenrechnung, Anlagebuchhaltung, Budgetierung, Kennzahlen und Reporting. Du bist verantwortlich für die Parametrierung der Abacus-Anwendungen in deinem Fachgebiet. Du berätst und begleitest unsere Kunden vor Ort oder remote. Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Lösungen bei. Dein Profil: Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und hast eine hohe Affinität zu IT und Digitalisierung. Du beherrschst die Grundsätze des Rechnungswesens und möchtest diese mit ERP-Systemen und digitalen Prozessen verbinden. Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert. Idea

jobs.title: Paid Working Student: Medical Device Design and Engineering
jobs.description: About Piomic Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Our lead indication is diabetic foot ulcers, a condition with one of the highest mortality rates in healthcare. Our breakthrough COMS® therapy (Concurrent Optical and Magnetic Stimulation) is a non-invasive treatment that delivers physical stimulation to deep tissue for wound healing. Our team of biologists, engineers and designers combines high-quality medical research with a close focus on the people who use our devices. Our vision: life shouldn't be defined by a medical condition. jobs.title: Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistent*in (Zürich)
jobs.description: Warum Ovivamed? Wir bei Ovivamed haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Wir machen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich. Hierzu bauen wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten auf. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen langfristig erfolgreich zu managen, indem wir uns auf das konzentrieren, was am meisten zählt: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu steigern. Bisher haben wir bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in Grossbritannien erfolgreich begleitet. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit! Die Rolle Als Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistentin (a) steuerst du das tägliche operative Geschäft unserer Ovivamed-Praxisstandorte in der Schweiz (Zürich, Bern, Basel, Luzern). In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Rolle führst du ein engagiertes Team von Medizinischen Praxisassistent*innen und Medizinstudierenden. Du stellst einen reibungslosen Patient*innenfluss sowie die kontinuierliche Einhaltung unserer hohen klinischen und operativen Standards sicher. Als mitarbeitende Führungspersönlichkeit arbeitest du aktiv im Praxisalltag mit, unterstützt das Team von der Front aus und befähigt deine Kolleg*innen gleichzeitig zu fachlicher und persönlicher Bestleistung. Deine Aufgaben: Teamführung & Entwicklung : Du leitest, mentorst und schulst bestehende sowie neue Teammitglieder vor Ort und förderst deren berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Praxisorganisation : Du überwachst und optimierst die täglichen Abläufe in den Praxisstandorten, um eine nahtlose Patient*innenerfahrung und effiziente, gut strukturierte Abläufe zu gewährleisten. Qualitätsmanagement : Du implementierst, pflegst und setzt unsere Qualitätsmanagement-Strukturen an den Standorten konsequent durch. Einsatzplan

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit. Die Stelle Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. jobs.title: Stage Bouw
jobs.description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe. As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent. If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together. Tasks Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact. Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates. Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports. Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved. Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off. Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases. Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines. Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes. Requirements 3+ years of experience in technical support , app

jobs.description: Über die dokSAFE GmbH Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung ACTAPORT spezialisiert hat. Du sorgst dafür, dass jede:r bei uns sicher, schnell und ohne Reibung arbeiten kann, vom ersten Arbeitstag bis zum Offboarding? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Inhouse-IT & Security verantwortest Du eigenständig den Betrieb und die Absicherung unserer gesamten Inhouse-IT (Workplace, Cloud-Services und firmenweites Identity & Access Management), inklusive Datensicherung, Monitoring und Patch-Management aller IT-Systeme. Du arbeitest in einem regulierten Umfeld, in dem Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit zum Produkt gehören. Bei infrastrukturnahen Themen unterstützt Dich unser DevOps-Team. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust den Endgeräte-Lifecycle von Beschaffung bis Entsorgung inklusive Softwareverteilung, führst ein vollständiges Inventar aller IT-Systeme (Endgeräte, Server, Netzwerk- und Speichersysteme, SaaS-Tools) und stellst sicher, dass Sicherheitsupdates zeitnah und nachweisbar eingespielt werden. Du administrierst Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Intune), Google Workspace, Atlassian (Jira / Confluence) und weitere SaaS-Tenants und behältst den Überblick über Tools, Lizenzen und Admin-Rechte. Du verantwortest unser firmenweites Identity & Access Management (RBAC, SSO via SAML / OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, Joiner-Mover-Leaver) sowie den Betrieb von VPN und Netzzugängen. Du verantwortest Datensicherung und Wiederherstellung (Backup-Konzept, regelmäßige Restore-Tests) sowie Monitoring, Protokollierung und Alerting unserer Systeme. Du pflegst die virtuellen Maschinen unserer Professional-Services-Umgebungen, steuerst Zugriffe auf Lab- und Migrationsumgebungen und stellst die richtlinienkonforme Nutzung der Fernwartungstools sicher. jobs.description: AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight. Position Overview We are seeking a SoC/ASIC Architect . The Silicon Team in Edinburgh is a small, highly focused group responsible for developing high‑value silicon that is core to AST’s mission of “Connecting the unconnected” - delivering the world’s first space‑based mobile broadband network. The team works collaboratively to define and build next‑generation silicon, exploring advanced silicon technologies to continuously improve performance, capability, and efficiency. This is a hands‑on environment where silicon decisions directly impact AST’s ability to deliver a global communications network from space. In this role, you will drive the architectural definition of complex System‑on‑Chips (SoCs) critical to AST’s satellite communications platforms. You will translate system and product requirements into high‑quality architectural specifications, guiding technical decisions from concept through implementation. Working closely with cross‑functional internal teams and external partners, you will help ensure timely delivery of robust, high‑performance silicon solutions.   Key Responsibilities: • Work cross‑functionally with hardware, software, verification, product, and systems teams to define and deliver SoC architectures. • Own and author high‑quality architecture and specification documentation. • Guide design trade‑offs across performance, power, area, security, and schedule. • Engage in design, verification, and implementation reviews to ensure architectural integrity. • Support silicon bring‑up and debug through close collaboration with validation and software teams.   Qualifications Education: BEng in Electrical Engineering, Computer

jobs.description: Founding Product Engineer London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available The Mission We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software. The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis. We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own. Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer. The Challenge As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will: Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for. Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence. Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap. jobs.description: In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners. We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We’re fixing this. We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Search & Recommendation - Patient Team (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Join our mission, join Doctolib! We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing. You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers). Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML. Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation. Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later. Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability. Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m) The opportunity Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced. More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe. For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey. This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance. We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like. What you will build and lead As Product Design Director, Patient , you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including: access to care, search and booking; patient messaging and teleconsultation; the Patient Health Record and patient context; the app homepage and daily health experience; health content and prevention; recommendations, reminders and care plans; new patient services and subscription experiences; conversational and AI-powered experiences. The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer . You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient

jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib. Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good. Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state. Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets. Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM. Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team.
